title: Fourier coefficients under coordinate reindexing
statement: Let $k$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\iota$ be a finite index set, and let $e:[k]\to\iota$ be a bijection. For any real-valued function $f$ on sign assignments to $\iota$ and any subset $S\subseteq[k]$, the Fourier coefficient at $S$ of the function obtained by reindexing inputs through $e$ equals the Fourier coefficient of $f$ at the image $e(S)$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is real-valued on sign assignments to $\iota$
